name: wow-addon-management
description: Manage World of Warcraft retail addons on Linux — packaged GitHub-release downloads (libs bundled, version pinned) + CurseForge API, with a Firecrawl-backed CurseForge reconciliation guard, relative-symlink management, library fetching, BugGrabber error analysis, WoW 12.x API-fix patterns, and gamescope/Hyprland display setup. Drives the tooling in ~/repos/WoW.
